name: sealed-pair
description: Sui-native MCP tools for the Sealed Pair sealed P2P OTC dApp — read open RFQ orders, verify settlement digests, look up maker reputation, query wallet history. Fills a real gap: Tatum's own official MCP doesn't expose Sui-native Blockchain Data tools yet (its native catalog covers EVM chains + Bitcoin family + Solana et al — Sui only via gateway_execute_rpc raw RPC). Compose both servers below to give an AI agent first-class Sui semantics AND raw multi-chain access in one config.

tools.name: list_open_orders
tools.description: List the most recent sealed RFQ orders. Returns orderId, blobId, pair, side, sizeBand, maker, expiry, escrow.

tools.name: wallet_history
tools.description: Tatum Data API surface — recent transaction blocks for any Sui address via suix_queryTransactionBlocks. Returns digest, timestamp, gas used, status.

tools.name: verify_settle_digest
tools.description: Confirm a Sui tx digest emitted OrderSettled from the deployed sealed_pair::order package.

tools.name: maker_stats
tools.description: Aggregate on-chain stats (posted, settled, cancelled, success rate, tier) for a maker address.

tatum-official.description: Tatum's official MCP server — 10 Blockchain Data tools (get_wallet_portfolio, get_transaction_history, get_metadata, …) + 4 RPC Gateway tools (gateway_execute_rpc, gateway_get_supported_chains, …). Native Blockchain Data tools cover Ethereum/Polygon/Arb/Op/Base/BNB/Avax/Fantom/Celo/Gnosis/Ronin/Chiliz + Bitcoin/Litecoin/Dogecoin/BCH + Solana/Cardano/Tezos/Stellar/Ripple/EOS. Sui is reachable via `gateway_execute_rpc` (raw RPC passthrough) — that's the surface our sealed-pair tools complement with Sui-native semantics. Set TATUM_API_KEY before starting the MCP client; if unset, omit this entry to avoid 401s.

notes: All sealed-pair tools are read-only and route through Tatum's Sui RPC gateway with server-side API key custody.
Mutations (create_offer, lock_with_escrow, settle, cancel_open, cancel_expired) require wallet signing and are not exposed.
GET /api/mcp returns the live tool catalog with full JSON schemas.

Why two servers: as of Jun 2026 Tatum's official MCP doesn't expose Sui-native Blockchain Data tools — Sui only via `gateway_execute_rpc` raw RPC. Our sealed-pair-http server fills that gap with Sui-native semantics (RFQ board state, OrderSettled provenance, maker reputation), and you still get Tatum's Blockchain Data tools for the 22+ other chains they natively support.
Compose 'sealed-pair-http' + 'tatum-official' in your MCP client to give an AI agent first-class Sui semantics AND raw multi-chain access in one config.
